sloka: तेन मे कथितं राज्ञा भार्या मे रक्षसा हृता ।तत्र साहाय्यमस्माकं कार्यं सर्वात्मना त्वया ।। ५.५८.१३६ ।।।।
transliteration: tena me kathitaṁ rājñā bhāryā me rakṣasā hṛtā ।tatra sāhāyyamasmākaṁ kāryaṁ sarvātmanā tvayā ।। 5.58.136 ।।।।

translations.english: 'The king said, ' My wife was abducted by a demon. I request your help by all means to get her'.
